shared_elements: incised linear motifs on a stone surface
concentric circle / disc motif (A) vs round pecked cups (B)
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic incised/pecked human-like forms on rock, and A's frontal figure with headdress and chest disc loosely echoes B's stick-like figures with raised arms, but this is the most generic level of correspondence. A depicts a single monumental frontal body with a face, headdress, arm-and-hand curves, a concentric disc on the torso and belt-like bands, while B shows multiple thin outline stick figures with raised arms combined with long straight lines and rectangular frames, with no comparable body ornament, face or hierarchical single-figure composition.
